Although my initial inquiry was about attaching a battery to the current system, given his extensive experience in the field he suggested a better course of action would be a complete replacement of the system to deliver greater savings. Chris had me sold with his knowledge surrounding the solar industry in general, the  government rebates available and pricing. On agreeing to proceed with the purchase of a new system, the application process was seamless thanks to Chris.On the day of installation, the installers turned up on time and were polite. They kept me informed, providing me with all the necessary information. On completion of the installation, they cleaned up after themselves and gave me an opportunity to run through the display on the inverter and ask any questions. The installer advised me that commissioning of the system would be scheduled.Chris called the following day to follow-up on the installation, answer any further questions and advise that he would be in contact once a commissioning date was available.I would highly recommend Alliance Solar to any prospective buyer.
